content: Good morning, beautiful. I woke up thinking about your smile again. Did you sleep well last night? I can't wait until we can finally meet in person.
Good morning! You're so sweet. I wish you were here to give me a real hug. I miss you so much already.
You have no idea how much I cherish our talks. You're my light out here on this lonely rig. Counting the days until I can hold you. How's your day looking?
I'm just working from home. It feels empty since the divorce, but talking to you keeps me going. Are you okay out there? Is everything alright with your work?

Thank you, darling. It means the world to me that you care. Actually, I'm dealing with a bit of a snag right now. My company delayed my offshore allowance this month, and they require me to pay a satellite service fee before I can request leave. It's embarrassing to admit, but I'm stuck until it's paid.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help? You know I care about you.

You're so caring, it's one of the things I love about you. I wouldn't ask if it wasn't urgent, I'm truly at a loss. If you could help cover the $1,250 satellite fee, I'd pay you back the moment I'm home. I hate putting you in this position.
I want to help, but that's a lot of money. Are you sure there's no other way? It's just... I've never done this before.

I completely understand your hesitation, love. You have such a generous heart, and I'd never take advantage. My company is strict with these offshore policies. All I need is this one favor, and then I can finally come see you. You're my only hope right now.
I trust you, I really do. But I'm worried. What if something goes wrong?

I promise, nothing will happen to your money. You're the most important person in my life, and I'd never let you down. As soon as I'm back, I'll reimburse you, and take you to that little Italian restaurant we always talk about.
That sounds wonderful. Okay... how do I send it to you?

Thank you, darling. You're truly an angel. The offshore service only accepts Zelle transfers. Could you send it to my assistant's account? Her name is Lisa Carter. The email for Zelle is carter.lisa24@gmail.com. Once it's completed, just send me a screenshot so I can confirm on my end.
Alright, I'll try to send it now. Do you need any other details from me?
Just your full name as it appears on your bank account, so my assistant can verify the transfer. You're so thoughtful and trustworthy, I'm grateful every day to have found someone like you.
My name is Patricia Evans. I'm sending it from my Chase account. I just want to make sure it goes through okay.
Thank you so much, Patricia. You're making my world brighter. Once the transfer is done, let me know, and I'll get straight to requesting my leave so I can start planning our future together.
Okay, I'm sending it now. I really hope this helps and that you can come home soon.
You have the most beautiful heart. I'm already dreaming of the day I can hold you and thank you in person. Please let me know once you've sent the confirmation.
I just sent the payment! I attached the screenshot here. Please confirm you got it.
I see it, thank you, my love. You're incredible. I'll keep you updated every step of the way. I'm so lucky to have you in my life.
